title: Derechos del consumidor: ticket de compra, garantía de 3 años y Hojas de Reclamaciones

words.translation: official Consumer Complaint Form (mandatory in all shops and bars)
statutory warranty (3 years for new durable goods in Spain)
right of withdrawal (14 calendar days for online/distance purchases)
Municipal Consumer Information Office (Oficina Municipal de Información al Consumidor)
product labeling (must appear at least in Spanish)
